title: द्वादशोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira learns of the plot and Arjuna promises never to turn away from fighting and not to let Drona seize him. Drona forms his array and drives against Dhrishtadyumna's troops.
summary.kn: ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಈ ಯೋಜನೆ ತಿಳಿದಾಗ ಅರ್ಜುನ ತಾನು ಯುದ್ಧದಿಂದ ಹಿಂದೆ ಸರಿಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ದ್ರೋಣ ಅವನನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯಗೊಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲವೆಂದು ಭರವಸೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದ್ರೋಣ ವ್ಯೂಹ ರಚಿಸಿ ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನನ ಸೈನ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ನುಗ್ಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर को योजना का पता चलता है और अर्जुन वचन देते हैं कि वे युद्ध से कभी नहीं हटेंगे और द्रोण को उन्हें पकड़ने नहीं देंगे। द्रोण व्यूह बनाकर धृष्टद्युम्न की सेना पर टूट पड़ते हैं।
summary.te: యుధిష్ఠిరునికి పథకం తెలియగా, యుద్ధం నుండి వెనుతిరగనని, ద్రోణుడు అతన్ని పట్టుకోనివ్వనని అర్జునుడు మాటిస్తాడు. ద్రోణుడు వ్యూహం పన్ని ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుని సేనపై దూకుతాడు.
summary.ta: யுதிஷ்டிரர் சூழ்ச்சியை அறிய, போரிலிருந்து விலக மாட்டேன் என்றும் த்ரோணர் அவரைப் பிடிக்க விடமாட்டேன் என்றும் அர்ஜுனன் உறுதியளிக்கிறான். த்ரோணர் வியூகம் அமைத்து த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னனின் படையைத் தாக்குகிறார்.
summary.ml: പദ്ധതി അറിഞ്ഞ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ; അർജുനനാകട്ടെ യുദ്ധത്തിൽനിന്ന് ഒരിക്കലും പിന്തിരിയില്ലെന്നും ദ്രോണർ തന്നെ പിടികൂടാൻ സമ്മതിക്കില്ലെന്നും വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്യുന്നു. ദ്രോണർ സേനയെ അണിനിരത്തി ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നന്റെ സേനയ്ക്കുനേരെ പാഞ്ഞടുക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.12; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततस्ते सैनिकाः श्रुत्वा तं युधिष्ठिरनिग्रहम् ।
सिंहनादरवांश्चक्रुर्बाणशङ्खरवैः सह ॥

meaning.en: Then the soldiers, hearing of the plan to seize Yudhishthira, raised lion roars together with the sounds of arrows and conches.

verses.text:
तत्तु सर्वं यथा वृत्तं धर्मराजेन भारत ।
आप्तैराशु परिज्ञातं भारद्वाजचिकीर्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: All of it, just as it happened, Dharmaraja learned quickly through trusted spies, O Bharata, as well as what Bharadvaja's son intended.

verses.text:
ततः सर्वान्समानाय्य भ्रातॄन्सैन्यांश्च सर्वशः ।
अब्रवीद्धर्मराजस्तु धनंजयमिदं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Then, gathering all his brothers and troops from every side, Dharmaraja spoke these words to Dhananjaya.

verses.text:
श्रुतं ते पुरुषव्याघ्र द्रोणस्याद्य चिकीर्षितम् ।
यथा तन्न भवेत्सत्यं तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् ॥

meaning.en: "You have heard, tiger among men, what Drona intends today. Let a plan be made so that it does not come true.

verses.text:
सान्तरं हि प्रतिज्ञातं द्रोणेनामित्रकर्शन ।
तच्चान्तरममोघेषौ त्वयि तेन समाहितम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona, destroyer of foes, made his vow with a condition, and he has fixed that condition on you, whose arrows never miss.

verses.text:
स त्वमद्य महाबाहो युध्यस्व मदनन्तरम् ।
यथा दुर्योधनः कामं नेमं द्रोणादवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: So today, mighty-armed one, fight close beside me, so that Duryodhana does not get his wish from Drona."

verses.text: अर्जुन उवाच

meaning.en: Arjuna said:

verses.text:
यथा मे न वधः कार्य आचार्यस्य कथंचन ।
तथा तव परित्यागो न मे राजंश्चिकीर्षितः ॥

meaning.en: "As I must never in any way kill the teacher, so, O king, I do not intend to desert you either.

verses.text:
अप्येवं पाण्डव प्राणानुत्सृजेयमहं युधि ।
प्रतीयां नाहमाचार्यं त्वां न जह्यां कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Pandava, I would give up my life in battle before I would face the teacher or in any way abandon you.

verses.text:
त्वां निगृह्याहवे राजन्धार्तराष्ट्रो यमिच्छति ।
न स तं जीवलोकेऽस्मिन्कामं प्राप्तः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra's son will never in this world obtain what he wants, to take you in battle, O king.

verses.text:
प्रपतेद्द्यौः सनक्षत्रा पृथिवी शकलीभवेत् ।
न त्वां द्रोणो निगृह्णीयाज्जीवमाने मयि ध्रुवम् ॥

meaning.en: Though the sky with its stars should fall and the earth be shattered, Drona will not seize you while I live.

verses.text:
यदि तस्य रणे साह्यं कुरुते वज्रभृत्स्वयम् ।
देवैर्वा सहितो दैत्यैर्न त्वां प्राप्स्यत्यसौ मृधे ॥

meaning.en: Even if the wielder of the thunderbolt himself helps him in battle, or with the gods and daityas, he will not reach you in the fight.

verses.text:
मयि जीवति राजेन्द्र न भयं कर्तुमर्हसि ।
द्रोणादस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठात्सर्वशस्त्रभृतामपि ॥

meaning.en: While I live, king of kings, you should have no fear of Drona, best of weapon-bearers and of all who bear arms.

verses.text:
न स्मराम्यनृतां वाचं न स्मरामि पराजयम् ।
न स्मरामि प्रतिश्रुत्य किंचिदप्यनपाकृतम् ॥

meaning.en: I do not remember uttering a falsehood, I do not remember a defeat, and I do not remember ever promising anything and leaving it unfulfilled."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च मृदङ्गाश्चानकैः सह ।
प्रावाद्यन्त महाराज पाण्डवानां निवेशने ॥

meaning.en: Then conches, kettledrums, mridangas and anakas were sounded in the Pandavas' camp, great king.

verses.text:
सिंहनादश्च संजज्ञे पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ।
धनुर्ज्यातलशब्दश्च गगनस्पृक्सुभैरवः ॥

meaning.en: The great-souled Pandavas gave a lion roar, and the sound of palms on bowstrings, most dreadful, touched the sky.

verses.text:
तं श्रुत्वा शङ्खनिर्घोषं पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः ।
त्वदीयेष्वप्यनीकेषु वादित्राण्यभिजघ्निरे ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the conch blast of the great-souled Pandava, instruments were struck in your armies also.

verses.text:
ततो व्यूढान्यनीकानि तव तेषां च भारत ।
शनैरुपेयुरन्योन्यं योत्स्यमानानि संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Then your armies and theirs, arrayed, slowly approached each other, ready to fight in the battle.

verses.text:
ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् ।
पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च द्रोणपाञ्चाल्ययोरपि ॥

meaning.en: Then a tumultuous, hair-raising battle began between the Pandavas and the Kurus, and between Drona and the Panchala.

verses.text:
यतमानाः प्रयत्नेन द्रोणानीकविशातने ।
न शेकुः सृञ्जया राजंस्तद्धि द्रोणेन पालितम् ॥

meaning.en: The Srinjayas, striving hard to break Drona's division, could not do it, for it was guarded by Drona.

verses.text:
तथैव तव पुत्रस्य रथोदाराः प्रहारिणः ।
न शेकुः पाण्डवीं सेनां पाल्यमानां किरीटिना ॥

meaning.en: In the same way your son's noble chariot-fighters, strong strikers, could not break the Pandava army, guarded by the diademed Arjuna.

verses.text:
आस्तां ते स्तिमिते सेने रक्ष्यमाणे परस्परम् ।
संप्रसुप्ते यथा नक्तं वनराज्यौ सुपुष्पिते ॥

meaning.en: Your two armies, each guarded by the other, stood still, like two flowering forests asleep at night.

verses.text:
ततो रुक्मरथो राजन्नर्केणेव विराजता ।
वरूथिना विनिष्पत्य व्यचरत्पृतनान्तरे ॥

meaning.en: Then the man of the golden chariot, O king, shining like the sun, came out in his armored car and roamed among the army.

verses.text:
तमुद्यतं रथेनैकमाशुकारिणमाहवे ।
अनेकमिव संत्रासान्मेनिरे पाण्डुसृञ्जयाः ॥

meaning.en: As he stood alone on his chariot, swift in action in the battle, the Pandavas and Srinjayas in their terror thought him many.

verses.text:
तेन मुक्ताः शरा घोरा विचेरुः सर्वतोदिशम् ।
त्रासयन्तो महाराज पाण्डवेयस्य वाहिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: The terrible arrows he loosed flew in every direction, frightening the army of the Pandava, great king.

verses.text:
मध्यं दिनमनुप्राप्तो गभस्तिशतसंवृतः ।
यथादृश्यत घर्मांशुस्तथा द्रोणोऽप्यदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: As the hot-rayed sun, at midday, is seen surrounded by a hundred rays, so Drona was seen.

verses.text:
न चैनं पाण्डवेयानां कश्चिच्छक्नोति मारिष ।
वीक्षितुं समरे क्रुद्धं महेन्द्रमिव दानवाः ॥

meaning.en: None of the Pandava side could look at him in the battle, enraged like Mahendra to the danavas, respected sir.

verses.text:
मोहयित्वा ततः सैन्यं भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान् ।
धृष्टद्युम्नबलं तूर्णं व्यधमन्निशितैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: Then, having bewildered the army, mighty Bharadvaja's son quickly shattered Dhrishtadyumna's force with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
स दिशः सर्वतो रुद्ध्वा संवृत्य खमजिह्मगैः ।
पार्षतो यत्र तत्रैव ममृदे पाण्डुवाहिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Blocking all directions and covering the sky with straight arrows, he crushed the Pandava army wherever Prishata's son was.
